exposure: Injudicious use of oxytocin and prostaglandins
cohort: 206 women with ruptured uterus managed at the WCTH Bannu, Pakistan from October 2016 to October 2018
finding: Uterine rupture was significantly associated with grand multigravidity, obstructed labor, previous C-sections, injudicious use of oxytocin and prostaglandins, and resulted in high maternal and perinatal mortality.
